name: When is the best time to consider a living room lighting upgrade?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider a living room lighting upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider a living room lighting upgrade is when you're noticing inadequate lighting, planning a larger home renovation, or simply want to refresh your living space. If you're experiencing dim areas, high energy bills from outdated fixtures, or a desire for more flexible lighting control, an upgrade is beneficial. It's also an excellent time to bundle with other projects like painting or flooring to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an upgrade when lighting is inadequate, during a renovation, or to refresh the space, especially if you want better efficiency or flexible control.
